correctness.rationale: Positive spanning supplies γ>0 with min_u <u,z><=-γ||z||. Active inequalities ||x||²−2R<u,x>≤2Rε+ε² force x_L=O(ε), x_perp=O(√ε); inactive constraints have strict slack. Set x=εz+√ε y, and rescaled domain tends to {(z,y): ||y||²≤2R, z∈(1−||y||²/(2R))P}. Dominated convergence and beta integral give exponent (d+k)/2 and the stated Γ coefficient. For k=d, exact radial solution sqrt(R²a²+2Rh)−Ra with h=ε+ε²/(2R) yields correction [d vol(P)−(d+2)M2(P)]/(2R), strictly negative because P strictly contains unit ball. Two 3D balls with center distance 2R independently have 2πR ε²+(4π/3)ε³, agreeing with rank1 formula.
residual_risks: The theorem assumes finite fixed centers and strict positive spanning; rank transitions or moving centers not treated.
